symptoms: Client crashed during EntityRenderersEvent RegisterRenderers for cataclysm_spellbooks

In AncientRemnantTransLayer.class replace the same renderer owner/type so constructor descriptors match current Cataclysm
Preserve all other JAR entry contents

static: Old renderer reference count became zero in intended classes
New renderer superclass/constructor descriptors validated with javap
912 other JAR entries retained identical decompressed content
runtime: User reported the patched mod seems to work

applicability: Cataclysm branch where Ancient_Remnant_Rework_Renderer is absent and Ancient_Remnant_Renderer is API-compatible
Verify current constructors/layer types before reusing on a different Cataclysm version
anti_patterns: Do not blame Embeddium/Oculus warnings merely because they appear earlier in the log
Do not treat permissive mods.toml version ranges as proof of binary compatibility
